The gas that is produced turns damp red litmus paper blue.
Which row is correct?
Each option lists, in order: behaviour of the ammonium ion in NH₄Cl; behaviour of the water present on the litmus paper.", "options": {"A": "Brønsted–Lowry acid; Brønsted–Lowry base", "B": "Brønsted–Lowry acid; Brønsted–Lowry acid", "C": "Brønsted–Lowry base; Brønsted–Lowry acid", "D": "Brønsted–Lowry base; Brønsted–Lowry base"}, "answer": "B", "explanation": "B is correct. In NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ → NH₃ + H₂O, NH₄⁺ donates a proton and acts as a Brønsted–Lowry acid. On the damp litmus paper, NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻: water donates a proton to ammonia and also acts as an acid. The hydroxide ions turn red litmus blue. A is wrong because water is a proton donor here, not a base; C and D wrongly classify ammonium as a base. The two acids act in separate reactions."}
